description: This file contains internal implementation details for the StatusOr class in the Abseil C++ library, including type traits, helper functions, and class templates for managing status and value data.

classes.name: StatusOrData
classes.description: Helper class template managing the storage and operations of the value or status within StatusOr.

methods.name: PlacementNew
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T in a pre-allocated memory buffer using placement new.

methods.name: HandleInvalidStatusCtorArg
methods.description: Handles invalid status constructor arguments (implementation in .cc).

methods.description: Terminates the program with the given status (implementation in .cc).
